name: no-slop-color
description: find-color: pick tasteful ground-and-figure color pairs from a curated library and apply them as CSS, Tailwind or design tokens.

interface.shortDescription: Curated color pairs for brands and websites.
interface.longDescription: find-color recommends distinct, tasteful ground-and-figure color pairs from a curated OKLCH library for a brief, names a default pick, and applies the chosen pair as CSS custom properties, Tailwind v4 theme tokens or W3C design tokens.
defaultPrompt: Find colors for a premium fine-dining restaurant.
Pick a color pair for this SaaS landing page and apply it to the Tailwind theme.
Replace this project's default palette with a curated one.
